info.name: Search Manager API
info.description:
Executable examples for Search Manager's public Search, Autocomplete, Track Search, Track Click, and API-key enforcement contracts.

Authentication and edition are independent environment axes. `api_mode` is `anonymous`, `keyed`, or `rate-limit`; `edition_mode` is `standard` or `pro`.

One collection-level prerequisite authority reads the request contract matrix, runs only compatible requests, and emits a visible `SKIP:` reason for an invalid axis, incompatible request, missing variable, or invalid rate-runner contract.

Source: https://github.com/LindemannRock/craft-search-manager
